news.title: Connor McDavid has a goal and four assists as the Oilers hang on to beat the Canucks 9-7
news.ruTitle: Коннор Макдэвид забил гол и сделал четыре результативные передачи, а «Ойлерз» продолжают побеждать «Кэнакс» со счетом 9–7.
news.description: — Connor McDavid scored a goal and had four assists as the Edmonton Oilers built a six-goal lead and held on for a 9-7 victory over the Vancouver Canucks on Thursday night.

news.title: Luca Cagnoni scores in OT in the Sharks' season-opening victory over the Panthers
news.ruTitle: Лука Каньони забивает в овертайме в первой победе «Шаркс» над «Пантерами»
news.description: — Luca Cagnoni rocketed a shot off goalie Akira Schmid at 3:14 of overtime and the San Jose Sharks opened the season with a 4-3 victory over the Florida Panthers on Thursday night.

news.title: Guenther has 2 power-play goals in the Mammoth's 6-0 victory over the Blackhawks
news.ruTitle: На счету Гюнтера 2 гола в большинстве в победе «Мамонта» над «Блэкхокс» со счетом 6:0.
news.description: — Dylan Guenther scored two power-play goals, Karel Vejmelka made 15 saves and the Utah Mammoth opened the season with a 6-0 romp over the Chicago Blackhawks on Thursday night.

news.title: Vince Dunn has a three-point night to lift Kraken over Flames, 6-1
news.ruTitle: У Винса Данна есть три очка, чтобы победить Кракена над Флэймз со счетом 6-1.
news.description: — Vince Dunn had a goal and two assists, Matty Beniers scored and had an assist, and the Seattle Kraken beat the Calgary Flames 6-1 in the season opener for both teams.

news.title: Panthers' Aleksander Barkov exits early at Sharks because of injury
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Пантеры» Александр Барков досрочно покинул «Шаркс» из-за травмы.
news.description: Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov left in the second period against San Jose on Thursday night after his left knee appeared to buckle during a scrum.

news.title: Rangers' Igor Shesterkin becomes 18th NHL goalie to score a goal
news.ruTitle: Игрок "Рейнджерс" Игорь Шестеркин стал 18-м вратарем НХЛ, забившим гол
news.description: Igor Shesterkin of the Rangers became the 18th goaltender in NHL history to score a goal Thursday night.

news.title: A fast first period sets the tone as the Wild open with a 3-1 win over Nashville
news.ruTitle: Быстрый первый период задает тон, когда «Уайлд» открывается победой над «Нэшвиллом» со счетом 3:1.
news.description: — Nick Foligno and Blake Coleman scored first-period goals, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Nashville Predators 3-1 on Thursday night in the...

news.title: Olympic hero Jack Hughes scores in OT to lift the Devils over the Flyers 3-2
news.ruTitle: Олимпийский герой Джек Хьюз забивает гол в овертайме и побеждает «Дьяволов» над «Флайерз» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Jack Hughes scored with 1:37 left in overtime to lift the New Jersey Devils to a 3-2 win over the Philadelphia Flyers on Thursday night.

news.title: Igor Shesterkin becomes first Rangers goalie to score in 5-1 win over Lightning in home opener
news.ruTitle: Игорь Шестеркин стал первым вратарем «Рейнджерс», забившим гол в матче против «Лайтнинг» со счетом 5:1 в первом домашнем матче
news.description: — Igor Shesterkin became the first New York Rangers goalie to score when he lofted the puck the length of the ice into an empty net, capping a 5-1 victory over the Tampa Bay Lightning on Thursday night.

news.title: Knies has 2 goals and an assist in Columbus debut as Blue Jackets beat Sabres 6-3
news.ruTitle: На счету Наниса 2 гола и результативная передача в дебютном матче "Коламбуса", когда "Блю Джекетс" обыграли "Сэйбрз" со счетом 6-3.
news.description: — Matthew Knies had two goals and an assist in his Columbus debut and the Blue Jackets beat the Buffalo Sabres 6-3 on Thursday night for their first season-opening victory in five years.

news.title: Lightning's Hedman returns to ice 'energized' after lost season
news.ruTitle: Хедман из «Лайтнинг» возвращается на лед «заряженным» после проигранного сезона
news.description: Lightning captain Victor Hedman played in his first NHL game Thursday since stepping away in March to address his mental health.

news.title: NHL's Gary Bettman monitoring how no-trade clauses are used
news.ruTitle: Игрок НХЛ Гэри Беттмэн следит за тем, как используются положения о запрете обмена
news.description: NHL commissioner Gary Bettman believes that no-trade clauses are no longer being used as "originally intended," and instead, players are using them to force moves to specific teams after requesting a trade.
